attachments.origin_landmark: lateral tibial condyle + proximal lateral shaft, interosseous membrane

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: mid-belly endplate band -- for where this band lies along the muscle, see motor_endplate_zones

functional_compartments.function_note: Most superficial, most powerful ankle dorsiflexor; commonly used clinical/EMG landmark muscle.
functional_compartments.source: Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset; Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell)

motor_endplate_zones.notes: This line runs DISTAL to PROXIMAL, so 70-80% is near the fibular head -- the proximal third of the leg. Expressed on the muscle's own origin-to-insertion axis this would be roughly 0.2-0.3, the inverse of the published number, which is exactly why the zone is stored in the source's terms and not converted.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Diaconu S et al. (Elias University Hospital), 'A Visual Guide to Ultrasound-Guided Botulinum Toxin Injection in Spasticity, Part IV -- Distal Lower Limb Muscles', Toxins 17(10):508 (2025), doi:10.3390/toxins17100508 -- review synthesis of the intramuscular neural arborization literature it cites (Lee, Yi and others)

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998); Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset
